notes.title: Update Ver. 1.3.1 is now available
notes.content:
Ver.1.3.1 (Updated 7/30/2020)

* A new gameplay style, "LEGEND," has been added.
* Various minor issues have been fixed.
* Display errors have been fixed.

notes.title: Update Ver. 1.2.2 is now available
notes.content:
Ver.1.2.2 (Updated 7/17/2020)

* Fixed an issue that the game difficulty data may not be copied when the save data is copied in the FILE SELECT.

notes.title: Update Ver. 1.2.1 is now available
notes.content:
Ver.1.2.1 (Updated 7/16/2020)

* Fixed an issue that auto save is not done, after clearing the "BOSS RUSH" mode added in Ver.1.2.0.

notes.title: Update Ver. 1.2.0 is now available
notes.content:
Ver.1.2.0 (Updated 7/16/2020)

* The new "Boss Rush" mode has been added. (Once certain in-game conditions are met, this mode will be added to the Title Screen)
* An issue that was causing the game to crash in Stage 7 after passing through a warp gate has been fixed.
* An issue that was causing one of Alfred's sub-weapons to not pierce enemy shields when it was supposed to has been fixed.
* An issue that was causing Alfred's Voltaic Ray to not behave properly against a certain boss has been fixed.
* An issue that was causing a certain enemy to not behave properly has been fixed.
* An issue that was causing a certain boss to not behave properly has been fixed.
* Various display issues have been fixed.

notes.title: Update Ver. 1.1.2 is now available
notes.content:
Ver.1.1.2 (Updated 7/14/2020)

* Players can select the controller for each player under CONTROL SETTINGS P1 and CONTROL SETTINGS P2 on the title screen.

  Utilizing this option will allow players using Remote Play Together to assign the appropriate controllers to each player.

notes.title: Update Ver. 1.1.1 is now available
notes.content:
* Update Ver. 1.1.1 is now available

Ver.1.1.1 (Updated 7/10/2020)

The way the game detects controllers has been changed.

If the game is started without a controller, please go to the Options Menu and select the 「DETECT CONTROLLER」function once the controller is plugged in before playing.

This update may fix the issue that some PCs are having that is causing the game's framerate to slightly dip at certain intervals.
Should you still experience this framerate drop even after the update, please let us know, and we will continue to look into the issue.


* In regards to issues with not being able to use Xbox controllers

We have been able to confirm compatibility with the following the XboxOne controller and Xbox360 controller through in-house tests by the develpment team.

 - Xbox Wireless Controller and Cable for Windows
　　LOT NO./DATE: 1929
　　MFG DATE: 0719
　　WO: A97242

 - Xbox360 Controller for Windows (X811616-006)

We have confirmed that this controller works using USB 3.0 and standard Windows drivers (the Steam default settings).

We are also trying to collect as much information as we can on Xbox One controllers that aren't working and the PC specs that go along with them.
If you have an Xbox One controller that is not working, please let us know as much as you can about your type of controller (things like the type and model number would be quite helpful) and we will continue to look into the issue.
